description: Zomato is a food ordering and restaurant platform. Its developer-facing documentation covers POS integrations for restaurant partners and an MCP server that can act on a user's Zomato account.
summary: Zomato exposes a partner-only POS Integration REST API on zomato.com plus an OAuth-protected MCP server at mcp-server.zomato.com; no public GraphQL API or CLI was found.
